map.鼻阻力 R = ΔP / V (Pa/(cm³/s))。总鼻阻力计算公式：R总: Nasal resistance R = ΔP / V (Pa/(cm³/s)). Total nasal resistance is calculated as R total = (R left × R right) / (R left + R right). Common reference pressure points are 75 Pa, 150 Pa and 300 Pa, with 150 Pa the most frequently used. Measuring nasal resistance is an objective way to assess nasal ventilation and can be used to quantify obstruction, evaluate drug response and compare findings before and after surgery.

map.前鼻测压右鼻阻力 0.45 Pa·s/cm³（正常<0.3），左侧 0.18，提: Anterior rhinomanometry gives a right nasal resistance of 0.45 Pa·s/cm³ (normal under 0.3) against 0.18 on the left, indicating right nasal obstruction such as septal deviation or turbinate hypertrophy, so nasal endoscopy is recommended.

map.成人总鼻阻力约 0.1–0.3 Pa·s/cm³（150 Pa 压差下），受流量: Total nasal resistance in adults is about 0.1-0.3 Pa·s/cm³ at a 150 Pa pressure difference; it is affected by flow and nasal condition, and the two sides can be asymmetric.
map.与鼻声反射关系？: How does it relate to acoustic rhinometry?
map.鼻阻力反映总体通畅度，鼻声反射（Acoustic Rhinometry）反映局部: Nasal resistance reflects overall patency while acoustic rhinometry reflects local cross-sectional area, so the two assess nasal structure in a complementary way.
